The null subspace's TOTAL weight and every positive mode ARE reproducible.  This is a property of the published construction, exposed by re-running it; it is disclosed, not repaired.
null_subspace_disclosure.affects: SM Fig-S3 LEFT and CENTER scree bars k = 0, 1 only

qk_transcription.quote: npred2 = einsum('ia,ab,ib->i', W55, S55, W55); c_pred = einsum('iak,ia->ik', VP, W55 @ S55); qk = c_pred**2 / maximum(npred2, 1e-16)[:, None]
